about: The goal tree. Only the founder edits this file (the decision gate); agents propose changes in a pull request. North Star: goal (one sentence) and north_star (metric, unit, baseline, target, current, by). cycles: C1, C2 with start and end (6 weeks before product-market fit). objectives: O1 with cycle, owner, status (planned, active, achieved or cancelled) and 2 to 4 key_results (O1.1: metric, baseline, target, current, optional stage it proves). initiatives: I1 with title, key_result, owner, status (planned, active, done or dropped), optional epic. Tickets carry initiative:I1 and goal:O1. The okr-plan skill drafts it once the business model (stage 3) is approved; `python tools/goals.py update O1.1 --value N` records values.
